sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Silver Ship Wheel Evil Eye Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Navigate your day with style and protection. This dainty silver-toned bracelet features a sparkling ship wheel with a protective evil eye center. A high-fashion statement piece, it maintains its radiant shine best when kept dry and stored safely away from perfumes and moisture after every wear.
